person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: Meet the Switch Willo Team!

person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: Glenn Johnson began riding at Switch Willo in 1965. Early in his career he rode Cricket—an ex-bucking horse—to numerous Grand Prix wins at The American Gold Cup, American Invitational, and Winter Equestrian Festival (Wellington, FL).

person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: FOUNDER, OWNER & TRAINER

person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: A lifelong love of horses and the hunter jumper sport inspires Phoebe Johnson to provide exceptional training for Switch Willo riders and horses. After she started riding at age 12 at local barn Hobby Horse, her father bought two horses for Phoebe and her sister and purchased the first seven acre parcel of Switch Willo land.

person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: Kirk Berlin has been involved with horses for over 40 years. When he moved to Austin to attend college, he rode at Switch Willo as an amateur. Upon completing his education he chose to stay on at SWS and turn professional.

person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: Cindi Wallace has been riding horses for the past 25 years and joined the Switch Willo family in 2008 as a boarder with her horse Pendleton.

person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: Holly Mortimer started at Switch Willow Stables, and has been involved in the hunter/jumper world for at least 25 years, managing show offices of many of the Centex and Greater Houston shows.

person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: SWITCH WILLO CAMP DIRECTOR Riley brings a lifelong love of horse camp, along with a deep passion for mentorship to her role here at Camp Switch Willo. A lifelong rider herself, she grew up attending both day camps and sleepaway camps before later working as a wrangler and helping with the care and management of horse herds.

person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: Beverly Manroe began her long career at age nine in Houston at a hunter/jumper barn called Parish Stables. She took lessons there for several years and became good enough so that when Mr. Parish left town, he’d put her in charge of teaching as well.

person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: Kylie Wiggins first entered Switch Willo Stables when she was only 5 years old. Little did she know that this would soon become her home away from home. She began competing at the local shows when she turned 6 and by the time she was in her teens was competing at the 3 foot level.

person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: Natalie graduated with a degree in equine studies and participated on their Varsity IHSA team. She has been riding for over 25 plus years. Natalie spent 5 years in Houston where she was able to train, compete and teach students of all levels at Fort Bend Equestrian Center.

person_evidence_blocks.page_title: Team | Meet Our Expert Team - Join Today — Switch Willo Stables
person_evidence_blocks.text: Wendy grew up with horses and competed in 4-H and local shows in southern Michigan. At Ball State University she joined the IHSA equestrian team under Coach Mindy McMinn (later Darst) and had a blast rolling around central Indiana and Ohio in the team’s elderly RV.
